name: ghitu_lavarunner_instant_and_sorcery_give_haste
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'As long as there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+0 and has haste.' Seat 0's graveyard holds an instant (Quick Study) and a sorcery (Crash Through). Seat 0 casts Ghitu Lavarunner: it is 2/2 with haste, attacks the turn it entered and deals 2 to seat 1.
